export_data.name: Export data
export_data.description: Writes the whole Room Tiles setup (areas, tiles, catalog, maps, markers) to a JSON file in your config folder.

file.name: File
file.description: A .json file name, relative to the config folder.

import_data.name: Import data
import_data.description: Replaces the whole Room Tiles setup with a JSON file from your config folder. The current setup is saved to room_tiles_backups/ first; a file that isn't valid changes nothing.

file.name: File
file.description: A .json file name, relative to the config folder.

set_tile.name: Set tile
set_tile.description: Puts a tile in an area's grid. With only an entity, its kind and name come from the catalog; with no entity and no kind the slot is cleared; kind 'map' needs no entity.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Tile position, counted from 0, row by row.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Tile type. Leave empty to use the catalog's.

name.name: Name
name.description: This tile's own short name (at most 15 characters). Leave empty to use the entity's short name.

clear_tile.name: Clear tile
clear_tile.description: Empties one slot of an area's grid.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Tile position, counted from 0, row by row.

move_tile.name: Move tile
move_tile.description: Swaps two slots of an area's grid (moving onto an empty slot is a move).

auto_board.name: Auto configure boards
auto_board.description: Replaces boards with their automatic tiles; new appliances, vacuums and pools are then added to them by themselves.

area.name: Area
area.description: Room Tiles area id (e.g. kitchen). Leave empty for every area.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: Tile grid: 5x2 (10 tiles) or 6x3 (18 tiles). Leave empty for both.

add_marker.name: Add marker
add_marker.description: Places an entity's icon on a map. Responds with the new marker's id.

x.name: X
x.description: X position in the map's units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Y position in the map's units.

show_name.name: Show name
show_name.description: Show the entity's name above its icon.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: The map layer (e.g. house, rooms). Default: the map's first layer.

update_marker.name: Update marker
update_marker.description: Moves a marker or changes its options.

x.name: X
x.description: X position in the map's units.

y.name: Y
y.description: Y position in the map's units.

show_name.name: Show name
show_name.description: Show the entity's name above its icon.

layer.name: Layer
layer.description: The map layer (e.g. house, rooms). Default: the map's first layer.

remove_marker.name: Remove marker
remove_marker.description: Removes a marker from its map.

reset_short_names.name: Reset short names
reset_short_names.description: Catalog entities' short names back to the ones Room Tiles suggests from their full names, as setting up does. Every entity's, or just the ones given. Returns how many changed.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Only these entities (leave empty for every one in the catalog).

set_short_name.name: Set short name
set_short_name.description: Sets the short name (at most 15 characters) an area or entity shows on tiles and the map. Pickers and dialogs keep the full name.

area.name: Area
area.description: The area to rename (give an area or an entity).

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: The entity to rename (give an area or an entity).

suggest_short_name.name: Suggest short name
suggest_short_name.description: A short name suggested from an area's or entity's full name, by Room Tiles' shortening rules. Nothing is changed.

area.name: Area
area.description: The area (give an area or an entity).

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: The entity (give an area or an entity).

set_area_lights.name: Set area lights
set_area_lights.description: Chooses what an area's lights button switches: every light in the Home Assistant area except the excluded ones (default), or one entity such as a light group.

entity.name: Use this entity
entity.description: Optional: switch just this entity (e.g. a light group). Leave empty for all the area's lights.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Lights in the area the button should leave alone (e.g. a display's backlight). Replaces the current list.

area_lights.name: Area lights
area_lights.description: Switches an area's lights as its lights button does. Toggle: if any is on, all go off; otherwise all go on.

catalog_add.name: Add to catalog
catalog_add.description: Offers an entity in the Room Tiles tile picker. Its tile type is worked out from Home Assistant unless given; its short name is suggested from its full name unless given (and flagged for review if it had to be shortened).

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Tile type. Leave empty to work it out.

short_name.name: Short name
short_name.description: At most 15 characters. Leave empty for a suggestion.

catalog_remove.name: Remove from catalog
catalog_remove.description: Takes an entity out of the Room Tiles tile picker. Tiles already using it stay.

set_area.name: Set area
set_area.description: Shows or hides a Room Tiles area, or moves it in the area order.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.description: Hide the area in Room Tiles (its tiles are kept).

position.name: Position
position.description: Where it goes in the order (0 = first).

auto_add_areas.name: Include new areas automatically
auto_add_areas.description: Areas added to Home Assistant later appear in Room Tiles right away (otherwise they arrive hidden).

auto_update_panels.name: Update panels automatically
auto_update_panels.description: ESP32 panels install a newer Room Tiles firmware on their own, when nobody is using them.

set_markers.name: Set markers
set_markers.description: Replaces all markers of one map in a single step (used by the map editor's Save). Each marker: entity, x, y, layer, show_name, and its id to keep it.

set_map.name: Set map
set_map.description: Replaces a map's drawing in one step (used by the map editor's Save). Fields not given are kept. Markers on a removed layer move to the first layer.

name.name: Name
name.description: The map's name in the map selector.

bounds.name: Bounds
bounds.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1]: the area the whole-map view shows, in map units.

ha_floor.name: Floor
ha_floor.description: The HA floor this map shows, if any.

openings.name: Openings
openings.description: Doorways / open boundaries [x1, y1, x2, y2] (dashed).

shapes.name: Shapes
shapes.description: Filled areas, each with a style (floor, water, grass, deck or paving) and its points.

zones.name: Rooms
zones.description: Rooms / spaces, each with id, name, points, area, label and outdoor.

links.name: Links
links.description: Jumps to another map, each with to (map id), at (point) and label.

layers.name: Layers
layers.description: Marker layers, each with id, name and min_zoom.

add_map.name: Add map
add_map.description: Adds a new, empty map (a floor, a yard...). Returns its id.

ha_floor.name: Floor
ha_floor.description: The HA floor it shows, if any.

remove_map.name: Remove map
remove_map.description: Deletes a map with its markers (and links to it). The last map can't be removed.

order_maps.name: Order maps
order_maps.description: Sets the order of the map selector.

order.name: Order
order.description: Every map id, in the new order.

set_appliance.name: Set appliance
set_appliance.description: Adds or replaces an appliance profile - the sensor an appliance tile reads.

appliance.name: Appliance
appliance.description: The profile: id, name and one or two units (label, type, preset, status entity, time and door entities, what clears done).

remove_appliance.name: Remove appliance
remove_appliance.description: Removes an appliance profile and its sensor.

clear_appliance.name: Clear appliance
clear_appliance.description: Marks a finished appliance as emptied (what a tap on its tile does).

combine_appliances.name: Combine appliances
combine_appliances.description: Puts two single appliances on one tile (the first on top); the second's tiles and markers move to the combined one.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the combined appliance (default: Laundry, Dishwashers, or both names).

split_appliance.name: Split appliance
split_appliance.description: Gives one unit of a two-unit appliance its own tile.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: The unit that gets its own tile.

set_pool.name: Set pool / spa
set_pool.description: Adds or replaces a pool / spa system - the sensors its Pool, Spa and Pool / Spa tiles read.

pool.name: Pool / spa
pool.description: The system: id, name, equipment layout (shared, separate, pool, spa) and each body's entities.

remove_pool.name: Remove pool / spa
remove_pool.description: Removes a pool / spa system and its sensors.

pool_set_target.name: Set pool / spa target
pool_set_target.description: Sets a body's heater set point.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: A Room Tiles pool / spa sensor (the combined one acts on the active body).

pool_set_heater.name: Pool / spa heater on / off
pool_set_heater.description: Turns a body's heater on (heat) or off.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: A Room Tiles pool / spa sensor (the combined one acts on the active body).

pool_set_on.name: Pool / spa on / off
pool_set_on.description: Turns a body on or off: on a shared system the spa on is spa mode; otherwise that body's pump.

entity.name: Entity
entity.description: A Room Tiles pool / spa sensor.

with_heater.name: With its heater
with_heater.description: Its heater follows: on with it, off when it goes off. Default: the spa's own setting (on unless turned off in its settings).

set_robot.name: Set robot vacuum
set_robot.description: Adds or replaces a robot vacuum profile - the sensor its vacuum tile reads.

robot.name: Robot vacuum
robot.description: The profile: id, name, its vacuum entity and (Matter) its operational error sensor.

remove_robot.name: Remove robot vacuum
remove_robot.description: Removes a robot vacuum profile and its sensor.

ignore_device.name: Ignore device
ignore_device.description: Ignores a found appliance, pool / spa or vacuum - or takes a set-up one out of Room Tiles - so it waits under Ignored on the Appliances page.

device.name: Device
device.description: The found (or set-up) device as the Appliances page lists it.

set_up_id.name: Set up id
set_up_id.description: When it's set up: its id - it's removed from Room Tiles.

set_area_light_entity.name: Area lights entity
set_area_light_entity.description: Whether Room Tiles makes its "Lights" light for an area (e.g. Kitchen Lights) (all the area's lights together, like the lights button). Off removes it, with its tiles and markers.

enabled.name: Make it
enabled.description: On: the area's lights button (and Room Tiles' light for it) - made once the area has a light. Off: none for this area.

accept_short_names.name: Accept short names
accept_short_names.description: Confirms the short names waiting for review (areas' and entities') as they are. Ones too wide for a tile stay waiting (the response lists them).

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Optional: only these. Leave empty for all of them.

vacuum_queue.name: Vacuum room queue
vacuum_queue.description: A robot vacuum's room queue: add, remove or move a room (an area), clear the queue, start, pause, skip to the next room, or stop and clear.

robot.name: Robot vacuum
robot.description: The robot vacuum's Room Tiles id.

action.name: Action
action.description: add, remove, move, clear, start, pause, skip or stop.

area.name: Area
area.description: The area to add, remove or move.

index.name: Position
index.description: Where to move it in the queue (0 = next).

start.name: Start cleaning
start.description: With add: start the queue if the vacuum is idle (never resumes a paused one).

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Room Tiles

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Room Tiles was updated. Restart Home Assistant now to finish the update?

missing_entities.title: Room Tiles uses {count} entities that no longer exist
missing_entities.description:
These are used in Room Tiles but no longer exist in Home Assistant. Replace or remove them in Room Tiles, or restore them.

{entities}

area_lights_override_removed.title: Room Tiles area lights changed
area_lights_override_removed.description: The entity these areas' lights button used was deleted, so it now switches all their lights: {areas}. You can pick another in Room Tiles.

appliance_question.title: {name} reported a state Room Tiles doesn't know
appliance_question.description:
In Room Tiles, open Appliances and say what it means.

{states}

panel_needs_firmware.title: Update {name}'s firmware
panel_needs_firmware.description: {name}'s firmware is older than this version of Room Tiles, so it only shows an update notice. It updates itself in a few minutes; if it doesn't, install the firmware again with a USB cable.

panel_needs_integration.title: Update Room Tiles for {name}
panel_needs_integration.description: {name} has newer Room Tiles firmware than this version of Room Tiles, so it only shows an update notice. Update Room Tiles in Home Assistant.

theme_problem.title: Room Tiles can't use the theme {theme}
theme_problem.description:
Fix it in the room_tiles_themes folder:

{problems}
